(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((w (cols g)))
           (grid-from-fn 4
                         w
                         (lambda (r c)
                           (if (!= (zero? (at g r c)) (zero? (at g (+ r 5) c))) 3 0))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((w (cols g))
         (mask (grid-from-fn 4 w
                 (lambda (r c)
                   (if (!= (= 0 (cell-at g r c))
                           (= 0 (cell-at g (+ r 5) c)))
                       1 0))))
         (objs (objects mask 0)))
    (if (empty? objs)
        (grid-from-fn 4 w (lambda (r c) 0))
        (let* ((best
                 (first
                   (sort objs
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (or (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
                           (and (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
                                (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                                    (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                                         (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))))))))
               (bb (obj-bbox best))
               (r0 (fst bb))
               (c0 (snd bb))
               (r1 (nth bb 2))
               (c1 (nth bb 3)))
          (grid-from-fn 4 w
            (lambda (r c)
              (if (and (>= r r0) (<= r r1)
                       (>= c c0) (<= c c1)
                       (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1)))
                  3 0)))))))
)

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((w (cols g))
         (mask (grid-from-fn 4 w (lambda (r c)
                 (if (!= (= 0 (cell-at g r c))
                         (= 0 (cell-at g (+ r 5) c)))
                     1 0))))
         (parts (objects mask 0))
         (largest-size (if (null? parts) 0 (apply max (map obj-size parts))))
         (kept (flatmap obj-cells
                        (filter (lambda (part) (= (obj-size part) largest-size))
                                parts))))
    (grid-from-fn 4 w (lambda (r c)
      (if (member (list r c) kept) 3 0))))))
